model_output.verdict: A marketing executive whose resume connects leadership and campaign work to substantial business results.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for senior marketing leadership! It follows your progression from Senior Marketing Manager to Chief Marketing Officer, with the teams, budgets and business results attached to the work.

The Viridian account-based marketing line is a model: it names the program you built and connects it to pipeline and win rates. At Novara, the product launch results are impressive, though a recruiter can't tell what you changed in the process.

Start with that launch line and add the change behind the numbers. Your resume is unlikely to be the thing holding you back for senior marketing roles; competition for the job and the strength of your network matter too.

cards.line: - I decided to revamp the product launch process, shortening time-to-market by 30% and increasing launch success rate to 90%, resulting in a $15M incremental revenue increase over 2 years.
cards.cannot_tell: The launch results are substantial, but a recruiter can't tell what changed in the process. Name the change you decided to make.
cards.example: I decided to revamp the product launch process by [process change], shortening time-to-market by 30% and increasing launch success rate to 90%, resulting in a $15M incremental revenue increase over 2 years.
cards.question: What did you change in the product launch process?

cards.line: - I built and executed a comprehensive account-based marketing (ABM) program that increased pipeline contribution by $50M annually, lifting win rates by 15% among Fortune 500 clients.
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It shows your ownership, the customers the program reached and two measures of its results.

fit.note: Your experience points to senior marketing leadership in technology, with global teams, demand generation and go-to-market work. The Novara role anchors that direction with a large budget and company-wide responsibilities.
